register_map.notes: 8-bit register pointer; auto-increment wraps past LED15_OFF_H to MODE1 and also from 0xFE..0xFF to 0x00.

access_model.notes: I2C register-pointer PWM controller. 16 channels, each with 12-bit ON/OFF counters.

operation_flows.description: Read LEDn OFF registers to get current PWM duty cycle

transaction.notes: Set register pointer to LED0_OFF_L (0x08) — then auto-increment reads through LEDn_OFF_H
Read LEDn_OFF_L + LEDn_OFF_H + LEDn+1_ON_L + LEDn+1_ON_H (4 bytes for 2 channels with auto-increment)

raw_encoding.notes: PWM duty stored as OFF_L (low 8 bits) + OFF_H (high 4 bits in bits 3:0)

power_states.description: Internal POR holds the PCA9685 in reset until VDD reaches VPOR; registers and I2C state machine initialize to default states.

power_states.description: MODE1.SLEEP = 0; oscillator on; PWM control active.

power_states.notes: PWM control registers should not be accessed within 500 us after wake.

power_states.name: sleep_mode
power_states.description: MODE1.SLEEP = 1; oscillator off; no PWM control possible.
power_states.notes: LEDn outputs cannot be turned on, off or dimmed/blinked.

evidence_spans.snippet: The last bit of the address byte defines the operation to be performed. When set to logic 1 a read is selected, while a logic 0 selects a write operation.
Default power-up value (ALLCALLADR register): E0h or 1110 000X
Default power-up values: -SUBADR1 register: E2h or 1110 001X
PCA9685 sends an ACK when E0h (R/W = 0) or E1h (R/W = 1) is sent by the master.
Mode register 1 controlling restart, external clock, auto-increment, sleep, subaddress and all-call response
The LEDn_ON and LEDn_OFF counts can vary from 0 to 4095.
The hardware forces a minimum value that can be loaded into the PRE_SCALE register at '3'.
It takes 500  s max. for the oscillator to be up and running once SLEEP bit has been set to logic 0.
Once the correct byte (SWRST data byte 1) has been sent and correctly acknowledged, the master sends a STOP command to end the SWRST Call
Minimum SCL clock frequency is limited by the bus time-out feature, which resets the serial bus interface if either SDA or SCL is held LOW for a minimum of 25 ms.

requires_human: The datasheet's prescale equation is garbled in the provided text; the IR uses the standard documented formula from the prose near Section 7.3.5, but please confirm against the rendered equation if absolute fidelity is required.
The structured source excerpt does not enumerate all six hardware address-pin combinations; only the default and several representative values are present, so the address list is partial.

The PCA9685 is a PWM LED controller, not a measurement sensor; the read_channels here model the user-visible PWM timing data bound to each LED channel, which may be interpreted differently by downstream consumers.
The dedicated TestMode register at 0xFF is included from the register summary but should generally be excluded from normal driver operation.
